summary: Iteration 39 - Verified (a) Settings.js hides 'overview' / 'residences' / 'registration_links' for App Owner and Super Admin (both list view and direct URL ?tab= access show the 'unavailable-for-role' placeholder), while keeping profile/privacy/biometric/notifications/language/user_management/add_admin visible; (b) Layout.js sidebar shows 'تذاكر الدعم الفني' link with data-testid='sidebar-support-tickets-badge' for both app_owner and super_admin; badge text = '1' with bg-rose-500 animate-pulse (correct red+pulse because open=1); link href='/app/super-admin?tab=support_tickets' and clicking it navigates correctly; (c) Backend GET /api/sidebar-alerts/support-tickets returns {open,in_progress,total_active} for owner/super_admin and zeros for other roles (verified with security role -> {open:0,in_progress:0,total_active:0}); unauth returns 403; (d) Profile save (multipart PUT /api/users/{id}/profile) and Privacy save (PUT /api/users/{id}/privacy) both respond 200 with the expected payloads. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/sidebar_alerts.py support_tickets_sidebar_alerts is clean — gracefully returns zeros for non-privileged roles; uses count_documents so it's fast. Good.
Settings.js renderContent guard uses `isHighLevelAdmin && [...].includes(activeTab)` which correctly blocks direct URL access to compound-level tabs. Filter logic is DRY via spread operators.
Layout.js fetchSupportCounts auto-refreshes every 60s (per PRD). Consider also clearing the interval on unmount to prevent leaks (verify that useEffect returns a cleanup function).
Badge color logic: `supportTicketsAlerts.open > 0 ? 'bg-rose-500 animate-pulse' : 'bg-amber-500'` matches the spec exactly.
ProfileSettings uses multipart FormData (full_name/phone/email/profile_picture). The save toast is triggered on success of PUT /api/users/{id}/profile which returned 200 in tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested paths (settings filter + placeholders + owner sidebar + super_admin sidebar + badge + navigation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: To bypass SessionSwitcher for app_owner, perform API login (POST /api/auth/login with username/password) then set localStorage 'token','user', and NAVIGATE DIRECTLY to /app/super-admin (not /app/dashboard) — this renders the Layout sidebar without the session picker. The support tickets endpoint requires role in ('app_owner','super_admin'); other roles get zero-object. Badge data-testid is 'sidebar-support-tickets-badge' (singular). Backend profile save endpoint uses multipart form (full_name required), not JSON. Privacy endpoint requires keys from allowed_settings list (profile_visibility, contact_visibility, activity_status, data_sharing, marketing_emails).
